On Sunday, instead of ads for pizza deals from Papa John's or the latest insurance pitch from Jake at State Farm, fans watching their favorite NFL or college football teams were shown a 30-second, black-and-white video of President Donald Trump. The ad, nearly identical to an ad released by the Trump presidential campaign in 2024, shows the president silently walking down a hallway, while his voiceover warns of a "final battle" to "cast out the communists, Marxists, and fascists" and "liberate America from these villains once and for all."

There was one noticeable difference. The ad that aired Sunday was "Paid for by the U.S. Government," courtesy of American taxpayers. Stated Claim / Post Context:
Mamdani refuses request to send Trump a selfie of him and Kimmel

Zohran Mamdani has refused to send President Donald Trump the selfie of himself with Jimmy Kimmel.  During an episode of Jimmy Kimmel Live on Monday (28 September), Mamdani appeared as a guest on the show where Kimmel asked whether the New York mayor could send Trump the selfie of two of them from the studio.   Mamdani drew laughter from the audience with his response: “Jimmy, I love you, but I love housing more”.  Kimmel also asked Mamdani about the US president’s texting style , whether he texts in all caps like the way he posts. Mamdani gave a brief and polite answer. “ Pretty standard”.
